text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I heard. Today's your birthday, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! To think Inari-senpai actually 
knows who I am... I'm so honored, su...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't have any regrets left...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, I haven't even given you my 
birthday wishes yet! Don't jump the gun!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look, the tea's already set up. We're 
going to eat, so follow me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, tea!? Did you go out of your way to 
make it for me!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If it's for my juniors, it's nothing at 
all! I've prepared some insanely delicious 
food too, so look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I tossed in heaps of carrots and simmered 
'em nice and sweet. That oughta make the 
Fox Spirit thoroughly pleased!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! Eat up, eat up! It's 
my special, ultimate inari su—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
